privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires creating a GeoPackage at /home/ga/GIS_Data/sensor_network.gpkg with table 'sensors'. Geometry: Point, CRS: EPSG:4326. Fields: model_id (String/Text) and install_year (Integer). One feature must be added in San Francisco with model_id 'EnvSense-X1' and install_year 2024. Ensure the agent saves edits (the pencil icon in QGIS should be toggled off or the save icon clicked).
